name: Custom Rush
author: Viper Studios Andy
description:
Attackers vs. Defenders. Attackers win by destroying enemy M-COMs. Defenders win by eliminating all enemy reinforcements. Recommended for 32 players.
Listed below are levels that have been pre-configured to immediately work with this Rush Template once imported into the Battlefield 6 Web Builder.
To use your custom levels, you will need to export them and upload them to the web-builder separately.
